description: Provision an AWS Elasticache Snapshot via the ACK elasticache controller. Fields mirror the elasticache.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 Snapshot spec.

cacheClusterID.description:
The identifier of an existing cluster. The snapshot is created from this
cluster.

kmsKeyID.description: The ID of the KMS key used to encrypt the snapshot.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

replicationGroupID.description:
The identifier of an existing replication group. The snapshot is created
from this replication group.

snapshotName.description: A name for the snapshot being created.

sourceSnapshotName.description: The name of an existing snapshot from which to make a copy.

tags.description:
A list of tags to be added to this resource. A tag is a key-value pair. A
tag key must be accompanied by a tag value, although null is accepted.

items.description:
A tag that can be added to an ElastiCache cluster or replication group. Tags
are composed of a Key/Value pair. You can use tags to categorize and track
all your ElastiCache resources, with the exception of global replication
group. When you add or remove tags on replication groups, those actions will
be replicated to all nodes in the replication group. A tag with a null Value
is permitted.

title: AWS Elasticache Snapshot
